Standalone exact checks of the key polynomial identity, finite spectra and direct matrix products passed on the listed configurations. Finite computations are corroboration not universal proof.

value.rationale: Complete exact spectrum and universal adjacency nonsingularity of a canonical infinite family of finite matrix-commuting graphs are natural global graph invariants. The two large incidence eigenmodules, residual algebraic levels and scalar-copy sector give a structural interpretation that cannot be obtained from previously known degree/clique/diameter/local common-neighbor data.
